#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
use te1_chess::{START_FEN, Te1Game};
use te1_search::{HistoryProfile, SearchLimits, SearchOptions, SearchResult, search};
use te1_tt::TranspositionTable;

struct PositionSpec {
    id: &'static str,
    fen: &'static str,
    moves: &'static str,
}

const DEPTH: u8 = 8;
const HASH_MB: usize = 16;

const POSITIONS: &[PositionSpec] = &[
    PositionSpec {
        id: "startpos",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "ruy_lopez",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1b5 a7a6 b5a4 g8f6 e1g1 f8e7",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "nimzo_indian",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 g8f6 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 f8b4 e2e3 e8g8 f1d3 d7d5",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "sicilian_classical",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 c7c5 g1f3 d7d6 d2d4 c5d4 f3d4 g8f6 b1c3 b8c6",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "queens_gambit",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 g8f6 c1g5 f8e7 e2e3 e8g8",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "caro_kann_advance",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 c7c6 d2d4 d7d5 e4e5 c8f5 g1f3 e7e6 f1e2",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "english_four_knights",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "c2c4 e7e5 b1c3 g8f6 g1f3 b8c6 g2g3 f8b4 f1g2 e8g8",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "kings_indian",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 g8f6 c2c4 g7g6 b1c3 f8g7 e2e4 d7d6 g1f3 e8g8",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "kiwipete_family",
        fen: "r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/2pP4/1p2P3/2N2N2/PPQBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
        moves: "",
    },
    PositionSpec {
        id: "quiet_middlegame",
        fen: "2r2rk1/pp1nbppp/2p1pn2/q2p4/3P4/2N1PN2/PPQ1BPPP/2RR2K1 w - - 0 1",
        moves: "",
    },
];

fn game(spec: &PositionSpec) -> Te1Game {
    let mut game = Te1Game::from_fen(spec.fen).expect("profile FEN must be valid");
    for mv in spec.moves.split_whitespace() {
        game.play_uci(mv).expect("profile opening move must be legal");
    }
    game
}

fn run(spec: &PositionSpec, profile_history_framework: bool) -> SearchResult {
    search(
        &game(spec),
        SearchLimits {
            depth: Some(DEPTH),
            ..SearchLimits::default()
        },
        Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
        Arc::new(TranspositionTable::with_megabytes(HASH_MB)),
        SearchOptions {
            threads: 1,
            deterministic: true,
            use_lmr: true,
            use_see_pruning: true,
            use_null_move_pruning: true,
            profile_history_framework,
        },
    )
    .expect("baseline profile search must complete")
}

fn assert_neutral(spec: &PositionSpec, off: &SearchResult, on: &SearchResult) {
    assert_eq!(off.best_move, on.best_move, "bestmove drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(off.score_cp, on.score_cp, "score drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(off.depth, on.depth, "depth drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(off.seldepth, on.seldepth, "seldepth drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(off.nodes, on.nodes, "node drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(off.qnodes, on.qnodes, "qnode drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(off.tt_hits, on.tt_hits, "TT hit drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(
        off.beta_cutoffs, on.beta_cutoffs,
        "beta-cutoff drift for {}",
        spec.id
    );
    assert_eq!(off.pv, on.pv, "PV drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(off.stopped, on.stopped, "stop-state drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(off.threads, on.threads, "thread-count drift for {}", spec.id);
    assert_eq!(
        off.hashfull_per_mille, on.hashfull_per_mille,
        "hashfull drift for {}",
        spec.id
    );
    assert_eq!(
        off.history_profile,
        HistoryProfile::default(),
        "OFF profile must remain zero for {}",
        spec.id
    );
    assert!(
        on.history_profile.quiet_ordering_reads > 0,
        "profile did not observe quiet-history reads for {}",
        spec.id
    );
    assert!(
        on.history_profile.quiet_search_traffic > 0,
        "profile did not observe quiet search traffic for {}",
        spec.id
    );
}

fn array(values: &[u64]) -> String {
    let body = values
        .iter()
        .map(u64::to_string)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(",");
    format!("[{body}]")
}

fn emit(spec: &PositionSpec, result: &SearchResult) {
    let p = result.history_profile;
    println!(
        concat!(
            "TE1_HISTORY_FRAMEWORK_BASELINE_PROFILE",
            "\tid={id}\tdepth={depth}\tbestmove={bestmove}\tscore_cp={score}",
            "\tnodes={nodes}\tqnodes={qnodes}\ttt_hits={tt_hits}",
            "\tbeta_cutoffs={beta_cutoffs}\tseldepth={seldepth}\thashfull={hashfull}",
            "\tpv={pv}\tstopped={stopped}\tthreads={threads}",
            "\tquiet_ordering_reads={quiet_ordering_reads}",
            "\tcontinuation_reads={continuation_reads}",
            "\tcapture_history_reads={capture_history_reads}",
            "\tcountermove_matches={countermove_matches}",
            "\tquiet_near_saturation_reads={quiet_near_saturation_reads}",
            "\tquiet_exact_saturation_reads={quiet_exact_saturation_reads}",
            "\tcontinuation_near_saturation_reads={continuation_near_saturation_reads}",
            "\tcontinuation_exact_saturation_reads={continuation_exact_saturation_reads}",
            "\tcapture_near_saturation_reads={capture_near_saturation_reads}",
            "\tcapture_exact_saturation_reads={capture_exact_saturation_reads}",
            "\tquiet_positive_updates={quiet_positive_updates}",
            "\tquiet_negative_updates={quiet_negative_updates}",
            "\tcontinuation_positive_updates={continuation_positive_updates}",
            "\tcontinuation_negative_updates={continuation_negative_updates}",
            "\tcapture_positive_updates={capture_positive_updates}",
            "\tcapture_negative_updates={capture_negative_updates}",
            "\tquiet_cutoffs={quiet_cutoffs}\tcapture_cutoffs={capture_cutoffs}",
            "\tkiller_updates={killer_updates}\tcountermove_records={countermove_records}",
            "\tquiet_search_traffic={quiet_search_traffic}",
            "\tquiet_component_bins={quiet_component_bins}",
            "\tcontinuation_component_bins={continuation_component_bins}",
            "\tquiet_base_bins={quiet_base_bins}",
            "\tquiet_ordering_bins={quiet_ordering_bins}",
            "\tcapture_component_bins={capture_component_bins}",
            "\tpositive_update_depth_bins={positive_update_depth_bins}",
            "\tnegative_update_depth_bins={negative_update_depth_bins}",
            "\tquiet_traffic_depth_bins={quiet_traffic_depth_bins}",
            "\tquiet_traffic_move_bins={quiet_traffic_move_bins}",
            "\tquiet_traffic_depth_move_matrix={matrix}"
        ),
        id = spec.id,
        depth = result.depth,
        bestmove = result.best_move.as_deref().unwrap_or("0000"),
        score = result.score_cp,
        nodes = result.nodes,
        qnodes = result.qnodes,
        tt_hits = result.tt_hits,
        beta_cutoffs = result.beta_cutoffs,
        seldepth = result.seldepth,
        hashfull = result.hashfull_per_mille,
        pv = result.pv.join(","),
        stopped = result.stopped,
        threads = result.threads,
        quiet_ordering_reads = p.quiet_ordering_reads,
        continuation_reads = p.continuation_reads,
        capture_history_reads = p.capture_history_reads,
        countermove_matches = p.countermove_matches,
        quiet_near_saturation_reads = p.quiet_near_saturation_reads,
        quiet_exact_saturation_reads = p.quiet_exact_saturation_reads,
        continuation_near_saturation_reads = p.continuation_near_saturation_reads,
        continuation_exact_saturation_reads = p.continuation_exact_saturation_reads,
        capture_near_saturation_reads = p.capture_near_saturation_reads,
        capture_exact_saturation_reads = p.capture_exact_saturation_reads,
        quiet_positive_updates = p.quiet_positive_updates,
        quiet_negative_updates = p.quiet_negative_updates,
        continuation_positive_updates = p.continuation_positive_updates,
        continuation_negative_updates = p.continuation_negative_updates,
        capture_positive_updates = p.capture_positive_updates,
        capture_negative_updates = p.capture_negative_updates,
        quiet_cutoffs = p.quiet_cutoffs,
        capture_cutoffs = p.capture_cutoffs,
        killer_updates = p.killer_updates,
        countermove_records = p.countermove_records,
        quiet_search_traffic = p.quiet_search_traffic,
        quiet_component_bins = array(&p.quiet_component_bins),
        continuation_component_bins = array(&p.continuation_component_bins),
        quiet_base_bins = array(&p.quiet_base_bins),
        quiet_ordering_bins = array(&p.quiet_ordering_bins),
        capture_component_bins = array(&p.capture_component_bins),
        positive_update_depth_bins = array(&p.positive_update_depth_bins),
        negative_update_depth_bins = array(&p.negative_update_depth_bins),
        quiet_traffic_depth_bins = array(&p.quiet_traffic_depth_bins),
        quiet_traffic_move_bins = array(&p.quiet_traffic_move_bins),
        matrix = array(&p.quiet_traffic_depth_move_matrix),
    );
}

fn main() {
    te1_eval::use_embedded_nnue().expect("embedded production NNUE must load");
    te1_eval::set_nnue_enabled(true);
    te1_eval::set_hybrid_enabled(false);
    println!(
        "TE1_HISTORY_FRAMEWORK_BASELINE_META\tevaluator={}",
        te1_eval::evaluator_name()
    );

    for spec in POSITIONS {
        let off = run(spec, false);
        let on = run(spec, true);
        assert_eq!(off.depth, DEPTH, "OFF search did not complete for {}", spec.id);
        assert_eq!(on.depth, DEPTH, "ON search did not complete for {}", spec.id);
        assert_neutral(spec, &off, &on);
        emit(spec, &on);
    }
}
